reply.text: Injury-proofing isn't really a thing anyone can promise you, but I can build a program around stronger, more resilient knees — quad, hamstring, and glute work with good control through range, plus some single-leg stability for the kind of forces skiing throws at you. If anything's bothering you in there now, that's a call for a doctor or physio first so I know what to build around. Otherwise, tell me what you've got for equipment and days and I'll get this set up.
